_note: Owner-adjustable STAKE -> IN-GAME REWARD table (Seekerthon demo surface). READ-ONLY, NON-CUSTODIAL: the game READS a player's ACTIVE native SKR stake (Solana Mobile / Seeker native staking, Stake.solanamobile) and grants these SMALL cosmetic/flavor perks as a thank-you. It NEVER custodies SKR, NEVER holds a withdrawable balance, NEVER mints. Rewards are deliberately SMALL ('small but something') a token thank-you, never pay-to-win. Tune minStake and rewards freely: a tier is matched as the HIGHEST minStake <= the player's active stake, and a tier unlocks its own rewards PLUS every lower tier's (cumulative). kind = badge | title | cosmetic | trickle. Keep this in sync with the hardcoded fallback in StakeRewardsResolver.DefaultTiers.
